title: The Heavy Rain
text:
Last spring, heavy rain fell on a small town for three days. The river rose quickly, and water entered many houses. Families moved to the school gym to stay safe.

Volunteers arrived to help clean the streets. They carried furniture and brought food to the people. Thanks to their help, everyone had a warm meal that night.

questions.text: How long did the heavy rain fall?
Where did the families go to stay safe?
options: To a hotel in the city

questions.text: Why did the volunteers bring food to the people?
options: The people had lost their homes and needed help
The people were on a holiday
The volunteers wanted to sell food
The people had no problems at all

questions.text: How did the town probably feel after the rain?

vocabulary.definition: a lot of rain or weight, more than normal
people who help others without being paid
chairs, tables, beds and other objects used in a home

paragraph_translations: W zeszłą wiosnę przez trzy dni na małe miasteczko padał obfity deszcz. Rzeka szybko wezbrała i woda weszła do wielu domów. Rodziny przeniosły się do szkolnej sali gimnastycznej, aby być bezpiecznie.
Wolontariusze przyjechali, aby pomóc posprzątać ulice. Nosili meble i przynosili jedzenie ludziom. Dzięki ich pomocy wszyscy tego wieczoru mieli ciepły posiłek.
